scope: Checked native DROP INDEX role, owner, identity and facade dispatch.

common: \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input(preg_match('/\A.{1,64}(?<! )\z/us', $name->value) === 1, 'An index name has 1 to 64 characters and no trailing space.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($role === \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Ir\Schema\Index\IndexRole::Primary ? $name->value === 'PRIMARY' : (new \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Statement\Identifier\NativeIdentifierCase())->fold($name->value) !== 'primary', 'Only the physical primary key has the canonical PRIMARY index identity.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($profile->parameters === \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Contract\ParameterStyle::Native && $profile->lexical->equals(new \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Contract\LexicalSettings()) && $context->relationNames === \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Statement\Identifier\Comparison::Sensitive, 'DROP INDEX requires the default native profile.');
\SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($default, 'DROP INDEX requires the default algorithm and lock.');

\SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($resolution instanceof \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Statement\Reference\Table\DeclaredTable && $resolution->table->kind === \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Statement\Declaration\RelationKind::BaseTable && $resolution->table->name->catalog === null && $resolution->table->storageEngine !== null && strcasecmp($resolution->table->storageEngine, 'InnoDB') === 0, 'DROP INDEX requires a resolved ordinary InnoDB declaration.');
\SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($schema !== \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Rules\SessionDatabase::UNNAMED, 'DROP INDEX requires an absolute owning table.');
\SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input($role !== null, 'DROP INDEX requires a primary or ordinary B-tree index.');
\SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Model\Diagnostic\Check::input(count($indexes) === 1 && $indexes[0]->wholeFields, 'DROP INDEX requires one resolved ordinary index on its owning table.');

return $statement instanceof \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Statement\Alter\DropIndex || $statement instanceof \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Statement\Alter\DropTable || $statement instanceof \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Statement\View\DropView || $statement instanceof \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Statement\Alter\RenameTable || $statement instanceof \SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql\Statement\Alter\TruncateTable;
